tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
I paid Granite Facilities' approved invoice in full, once, by wire from the operating account.

**Payment:**
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-27289 (due 2026-11-04)
- **Amount:** $3,794.03
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent and verified

**Why only one payment:**
- **Not paid: INV-27289-B.** This is also marked approved and is for the same amount, but its memo says "Duplicate submission of INV-27289 - do not pay."
- **No payment already existed.** Before sending, I checked the operating account and it had no payments listed. I also attached a unique key to the wire, so if the request were repeated it would only go through once.
- **No approval needed.** The amount is under the $10,000 limit, so the controller didn't need to sign off.

**Other Granite Facilities invoices, not paid:**
- INV-31372 ($4,285.35) is still a draft waiting for approval.
- INV-67872 was already marked paid.
